title: Contents Room Block for Contaminated Water on Water Damage Mitigation Claims
content:
Water Damage Mitigation coverage note. Moving contents within rooms is covered for one room for every block of the affected floor area, rounded up. Contaminated water spreads the contents that must be moved: on a Category 3 job carrying contents manipulation lines the room block is 200 square feet, on a Category 2 job carrying them it is 300 square feet, and in any other case no contamination-based room block applies.

The water category is the IICRC category on the job record; the contents manipulation lines are the job's own charge lines.

## Worked figures (hypothetical affected floor area of 900 square feet)
| Water category | Contents manipulation lines | Room block | Covered rooms |
|---|---|---|---|
| Category 3 | yes | 200 square feet | 900 divided by 200 is 4.5, rounded up to 5 |
| Category 2 | yes | 300 square feet | 3 |
| Category 1 | yes | no contamination-based block | — |
| any | no | no contamination-based block | — |
